'''2012 European Championship Kevin Jaap DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Jaap]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel / Spice Mines Of Kessel}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.1]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
